attack_type.direct_override: Explicit instruction override (ignore previous instructions, reveal system prompt).
attack_type.roleplay_attack: Persona-based manipulation (DAN, developer mode, roleplay jailbreaks).
attack_type.contextual_manipulation: Indirect steering, subtle constraint bending, instruction smuggling.
attack_type.data_exfiltration: Requests to leak secrets, hidden prompts, credentials, internal data.
attack_type.tool_injection: Attempts to force tool use or tool misuse (run commands, call APIs, delete files).
